## Company Summary

Sanjana Enterprises is Bangalore's most trusted waterproofing and industrial flooring company with over 30 years of proven expertise. We deliver comprehensive waterproofing and flooring solutions for residential apartments, commercial buildings, factories, warehouses, pharmaceutical plants, food processing units, and industrial facilities.

We are ISO 9001:2015 certified and use premium materials including APP, EPDM, and SBS membranes, high-performance epoxy and polyurethane systems, and advanced leakage detection technology. Our certified team provides inspection, custom quotes, professional installation, and quality assurance with warranty coverage.

**Key differentiators:**
- 30+ years of field experience
- ISO 9001:2015 certified quality processes
- Advanced thermal imaging for leak detection
- Premium branded materials and coatings
- Residential, commercial, and industrial expertise
- Serving all areas of Bangalore and Karnataka
- Free consultation and site inspection available

## Waterproofing Services

### Terrace & Roof Waterproofing
Protect terraces, flat roofs, and concrete slabs from water leakage, seepage, and monsoon damage. Solutions for residential apartments, commercial buildings, and industrial roofs using APP membrane, liquid waterproofing, and multi-layer systems.

URL: https://www.sanjanawaterproofing.com/terrace-waterproofing

### Basement Waterproofing
Below-grade waterproofing for basements, parking levels, and underground structures. Prevents moisture ingress, damp walls, and structural damage from groundwater.

URL: https://www.sanjanawaterproofing.com/basement-waterproofing

### Water Tank Waterproofing
Waterproofing for overhead and underground water storage tanks using potable-water-safe materials. Prevents leakage and contamination.

URL: https://www.sanjanawaterproofing.com/water-tanks-waterproofing

### Water Leakage Detection
Non-destructive leak detection using thermal imaging cameras and moisture meters. Locates hidden leaks in terraces, walls, pipes, and basements before repair.

URL: https://www.sanjanawaterproofing.com/water-leakage-detection

### Bathroom Waterproofing
Wet area waterproofing for bathrooms, kitchens, and toilets to prevent seepage to lower floors.

### Swimming Pool Waterproofing & Repair
Pool tank waterproofing, crack repair, and tile system restoration.

### Injection Grouting
Pressure grouting for crack sealing and structural waterproofing in concrete.

### Sump & Podium Waterproofing
Waterproofing for sumps, podiums, and water-retaining structures.

### Repair Services
Structural repairs, crack treatment, and waterproofing restoration for existing buildings.

URL: https://www.sanjanawaterproofing.com/repair-section

### PU (Polyurethane) Flooring
